summary: Cloudflare tool pack, built for output compression rather than API access: an MCP server hands the model the vendor's raw JSON and the model pays for every byte, so these three call the API and print only what changes a decision. zone-audit.py fans out over the per-setting endpoints (the batch settings endpoint is deprecated) and prints only the settings that violate a policy file, exiting 1 on a violation. dns-snapshot.py writes a canonically ordered JSONL snapshot of every DNS record and diffs it against a committed baseline, exiting 1 on drift and printing only the changed names. cache-purge.py chunks a purge to 100 operations per request, honours the 5-requests-per-minute plan limit, backs off on 429, is dry-run until --yes, and demands the zone name repeated as the value of --yes before it will purge everything.

credentials.min_scope: Zone Read + DNS Read for zone-audit and dns-snapshot, Cache Purge for cache-purge; every permission resource-scoped to the one zone (com.cloudflare.api.account.zone.<ZONE_ID>), never the account-wide all-zones wildcard, and no Edit permission of any kind
